name: Aïr and Ténéré Natural Reserves
subtitle: The Aïr and Ténéré Natural Reserves lie in north-central Niger, about 160 km north-east of Agadez, and cover the Aïr Mountains and part of the Ténéré desert.

facts.label: Area
facts.value: 7,735,370 ha in total: 6,456,392 ha reserve plus 1,278,978 ha Addax Sanctuary

facts.label: Location
facts.value: South-central Sahara, north-central Niger, about 160 km north-east of Agadez

facts.label: Terrain
facts.value: Two fifths in the north-eastern Aïr Mountains, the rest in the Ténéré desert

facts.label: World Heritage inscription
facts.value: 1991, under natural criteria vii, ix and x

facts.label: World Heritage in Danger
facts.value: Listed from 1992 owing to destruction caused by civil conflict

facts.label: Biosphere Reserve
facts.value: Designated a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in 1997

facts.label: Administration
facts.value: Run by Niger's wildlife directorate (DFPP) and the water and environment ministry

facts.label: Addax Sanctuary
facts.value: About a sixth of the reserve is a sanctuary for the addax

facts.label: Wildlife loss
facts.value: IUCN reported in 2008 that addax, ostrich and several vultures and eagles were locally extinct through poaching

parts.text: The Aïr and Ténéré Natural Reserves lie in north-central Niger, about 160 km north-east of Agadez, and cover the Aïr Mountains and part of the Ténéré desert. The reserve was inscribed on the World Heritage List in 1991 and placed on the danger list in 1992 after civil conflict. About a sixth of it is an Addax Sanctuary.
